agent_explanation: Shrunk 2-body head-on approach with large dt=0.033 and high G=4.83. Bodies fall toward each other reaching distance 0.15 at step 9 (inside softening 0.3) where forces/accelerations are largest. Fixed-dt leapfrog with only 25 substeps in the final outer step is insufficient to integrate the deep softened potential accurately, causing large systematic energy drift (potential -1054, kinetic 929 at step 9 vs E0 -82.6). Reducing dt to 0.01 while keeping everything else identical removes the violation, confirming timestep resolution as the cause.
